wish: someone should make an app that tracks my fitness without storing data online
spec:
Logs workouts (exercise, sets, reps, weight) by date and shows best set, estimated 1RM and a progress line per exercise.
Type an exercise, sets, reps and weight, tap Log set; pick an exercise to see progress; export or import a backup file.
Stores everything in this browser only; no account, no sync, no network.
notes: Data lives in localStorage; export/import JSON file for backup. No network.
